features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.desc: When you make a melee attack against a creature, it can't make Opportunity Attacks against you until the end of the turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.desc: You add your Charisma modifier to your Initiative. You can apply Sneak Attack without Advantage if the target is within 5 feet of you, no other creatures are next to it, and you don't have Disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.desc: As an action, you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by the target's Wisdom (Insight): on a success, an enemy has Disadvantage on attacks against others and can't make Opportunity Attacks against them, while a non-hostile creature is Charmed for 1 minute.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.desc: When you miss with an attack, you can reroll it with Advantage. Once per Short or Long Rest.
